reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address Cr–Zr interdiffusion, Al2O3 diffusion barriers, or ALD on Zr-alloys; it discusses Hf-coated refractory HEAs and general ATF cladding strategies, providing no specific support for the key premises.
premises: Cr–Zr interdiffusion causes failure of Cr coatings on Zr-alloys at high temperature
An ultra-thin Al2O3 layer can act as a diffusion barrier between Cr and Zr
ALD can deposit a dense, conformal ~10 nm Al2O3 layer on Zr-alloy substrates
The Al2O3 barrier will remain stable and adherent under thermal cycling and irradiation
The barrier will improve oxidation resistance and adhesion compared to direct Cr coating
